==Overview==
=== Format ===
* 10 teams participate
* Double Round Robin
* Matches are best of one
* Top six teams qualify for [[LEC/2022 Season/Spring Playoffs|Playoffs]]
** Top four teams play in the winners' bracket
** 5th and 6th play in the losers' bracket
